text.tspan: Because the probability of Steph Curry making a shot is high, the probability is higher for greater
numbers of made free throws. It is much less likely that he misses many shots, and so the probability
histogram is skewed to the left.
Is there a way that we can predict when the probability histogram will be bell-shaped, without having to
create the whole distribution to at the histogram? Consider the following situations.
